name: ChipInput
description: Token field: a widgets-only input whose values render as removable chips, with suggestion, validation and clipboard round-trips.

fields.spacing: double? - 4; the rendered gap between two neighbouring tokens
fields.removable: bool? - true; whether each token gets a remove button
fields.chipTheme: ChipTheme? - extra leg for this field's tokens only
fields.chipIconSize: double? - 12; icon size of the remove button
fields.alignment: PlaceholderAlignment? - middle; how a token sits on the text baseline

theme.notes: The field surface itself is the `input` component's `InputTheme`, passed as ChipInput.inputTheme.

strings.chipInputRemoveChip: Semantics label of each token's remove button.
